name: Loz Colbert
description: From within the Richard Steinitz atrium, the windows of the western wall frame a direct view of St Paul’s. The sounds are intended to suggest a dialogue between the two buildings. The organ carries the memory of an interior sacred space, while the 'dragged' field recording presents an external, mobile perspective — that of the street and its surroundings in motion. Together, these elements offer a contemplative interplay between inside and outside, movement and stillness, architecture and the past, as both sonic and visual experience.
bio: Laurence Colbert is a composer, performer, and Lecturer in Popular Music at the University of Huddersfield. He has been active professionally since 1988 as a touring, recording, and composing member of the indie band RIDE. Alongside this, Laurence’s practice encompasses sound art and research-led work: he recently presented a paper on styli-based approaches to field recording at the Newcastle Sound + Environment symposium (2025), and his installation works have been shown at venues across Oxford as part of the Audiograft festival
